subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw publish `runtime.providerUsage.read` as a supported plugin SDK API, with its exact-profile, no-refresh, token-free contract and fail-closed agent-scope requirement?
rationale: This is a new public plugin capability rather than a repair to an established API; code review cannot choose the permanent SDK contract or supported plugin use cases.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK API
options.body: Accept the documented exact-profile, token-free, no-refresh contract after live proof and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep usage reads host-internal
options.body: Decline the public SDK seam and move any needed quota workflow behind a host-owned command or usage service.

options.title: Request a narrower design proposal
options.body: Pause this PR until owners define supported plugin consumers and the intended long-term provider-usage API boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK API
recommendation.body: Accept the documented exact-profile, token-free, no-refresh contract after live proof and compatibility review.

likelyOwner.reason: No individual owner can be established from the supplied current-main history evidence without guessing.
